layman_headline: Market fear is extreme and getting worse — not the time to jump in.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a state of deep fear, scoring only 25 out of 100 on the sentiment scale and trending downward. Bitcoin is holding around $63,500 but faces a critical test at $65,000 — if it can't break through before Friday's jobs data, analysts warn it could slide to $60,000. The altcoin candidates on our watchlist are either already overextended after big rallies, or stuck in bearish downtrends with no clear reversal signal. None of the setups offer a compelling risk-reward for a new swing trade right now.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market mood is worsening and there's a major potential catalyst (jobs data) coming that could push prices sharply in either direction. Better setups will come when fear starts turning around or when a clear technical reversal forms.
expert_reasoning: Per my validated rules, Fear & Greed at 25 makes the short-term outlook genuinely ambiguous (Rule 3), and the safest call is HOLD rather than forcing a trade. BTC dominance at 56.4% is crushing altcoins, making alt entries especially risky. BTW and PUMP have already run 42% and 41% in 5 days respectively — chasing overbought momentum in extreme fear conditions is a recipe for getting caught in a reversal. MON and FET have RSIs approaching oversold (~34 and ~37) but both are in confirmed bearish structures below all moving averages with no reversal candle patterns. AAVE and LDO lack sufficient chart data to even evaluate. The CryptoSlate headline explicitly frames the $62K-$65K zone as a binary outcome dependent on Friday's macro data — this is not a setup with definable risk, it's a coin flip. I'm staying flat.

Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) is actively selling BTC — $395M sold — which creates persistent overhead supply

market_context: Bitcoin is consolidating at $63,500 in extreme fear (25/100, worsening trend). High BTC dominance at 56.4% is draining capital from altcoins, and a binary macro event on Friday makes this a poor time to initiate new positions.
context_banner: Extreme fear with a critical macro catalyst approaching — patience is the highest-probability trade right now.
